## Description

Replace ledger tables for audit events, signed note versions, consent receipts and issued invoices: each row stores the hash of the previous row (per tenant chain), triggers refuse UPDATE and DELETE for the app roles, and a daily job writes a signed digest to an immutable (time-based retention) Blob container and a scheduled job verifies the chain and alerts on mismatch. Hashes are integrity evidence, not a legally qualified signature.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an audit row, when an UPDATE or DELETE is attempted, then the database refuses it (test fails when the trigger is removed).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a row is altered by a superuser, when verification runs, then the chain mismatch is found and an alert is raised.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the daily digest, when it is written, then it lands in the immutable container and can be verified later.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
